lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Blobs within each column exhibit roughly uniform vertical spacing, creating a semi-regular 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the centers of the circular blobs, forming distinct grid-like nodes at the points of intersection on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high intensity (dorsal) to low intensity shadow (ventral) along each ridge line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark vertical indentation or linear mark is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending from the mid-lateral line toward the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, heterogeneous high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more regular blobs on the lateral flank.
